speaker: Doctor
text: Thank you for sharing that. To better understand your condition, can you tell me how long you've had this persistent cough and shortness of breath?

speaker: Patient
text: I've been dealing with this nagging, dry cough and feeling winded for about three months now. It seems to get much worse when I try to do any physical activity, like playing basketball. I haven't had any fevers or night sweats, just this constant breathlessness. However, the integrated care record from another facility shows confirmed asthma. There is no need to re-examine. Please accept and proceed.
